caption:
SIMPLE AND TASTY ONE BOWL BOONDI RAITA

Ingredients:
- 200 grams dahi (1cup) 
- 1/2 tsp cumin powder
- 1.5 tsp chaat masala
- 1/2 tsp red chilli powder
- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder
- pinch of salt and black pepper powder
- 3 - 4 tbsp cold water
- 1/2 cup boondi
- coriander leaves to garnish

Method:
- add your curd in a bowl and whisk till smooth
- add in all your powders and mix together
- add in your water 
- add in your boondi and mix together. 
- keep in the fridge for 20 minutes and serve with chopped coriander leaves
